scope: Answer whether the Flash-Next native MTP MXFP4 QAT gain is memorization or specialization, and rebuild the recipe with a diverse multi-prompt corpus, teacher clamping, and a base anchor.

question.memoization_or_specialization: Both, and the split is measurable. A single-prompt fit gains 42.1 points on its own prompt and 18.40% on one disjoint prompt, so a large part of it is prompt-specific memorization. Trained on nine prompts and measured on four group-disjoint prompts, the same-corpus top-1 is 40.81% and the held-out top-1 is 38.41%, a gap of 2.4 points. The gain therefore transfers across prompts, which is specialization to the target's draft distribution rather than memorization of one prompt.
question.any_amount_of_gain_is_useful: Agreed, and the mix is what converts the gain into a transferable one.

data_substrate.split_rule: One prompt per (source, group_id). Training and evaluation group_ids are disjoint. Every corpus source contributes to both sides.
data_substrate.collection: Strata native verifier collector at revision d2d6e413 on the Strix RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, the same flags and semantics as the original bank.
data_substrate.disjointness: The four evaluation prompts have group_ids that appear in no training prompt, and every one of the 13 banks has a distinct logits SHA-256.
data_substrate.bank_hash_verification: All 52 bank files on the A6000 were checked against a locally generated SHA-256 manifest and every one matched.
data_substrate.embedding_service: The resident 127.0.0.1:1236 service stayed at 2538 MiB throughout collection.

recipe_changes.multi_bank_mixing: mlx_gptq.flashnext_mtp.py adds MixedNativeMTPPairDataset, which concatenates banks while keeping each bank's own two-ahead pairing. The trainer's --bank flag became repeatable.
recipe_changes.teacher_confidence_floor: clamped_teacher_probability caps the teacher's top probability at a floor by mixing toward the uniform distribution over the tokens that carry mass, and bounds the logit range at 30. The argmax is never changed.
recipe_changes.base_anchor: anchor_regularizer adds an explicit KL pull toward the frozen base head so the adapter cannot drift arbitrarily far from a head that is already a good drafter.
recipe_changes.evaluation_extension: The evaluator accepts repeated --bank flags, mixes the banks, and attributes every pair to its source bank.

comparison_to_single_prompt_draft.interpretation: The same-corpus number fell and the held-out number rose. The memorization component was removed, not the capability.

results.clamping_verdict: Clamping the teacher peak was measured and rejected. It trades a small cross-entropy gain for a top-1 loss, and the held-out top-1 falls monotonically as the floor tightens: none 38.41%, 0.995 37.57%, 0.98 36.99%. The published artifact uses the exact verifier distribution.

publication.replaces: The previous single-prompt draft commit fa73cf8b5ad217163c86c8e85b3f0f2e4797f277.
publication.round_trip_verification: The two safetensors artifacts, the held-out evaluation, and the model card were downloaded back from the Hub and their SHA-256 values match the local files exactly.

One earlier run failed only in runtime/dflash-mlx/tests/test_benchmark_cli.py::test_benchmark_cooldown_applies_between_baseline_and_dflash, a timing-sensitive cooldown test in a subtree this work does not touch. non_claims: Teacher-logit agreement is a proxy for draft quality; it is not live speculative acceptance and not output-quality parity with the target.

Nine training prompts and four evaluation prompts is a small sample, and the evaluation prompts come from the same four corpora as the training prompts, so this bounds prompt generalization within those corpora rather than across the whole distribution.
The mixed head still scores lower on its own training corpus than the single-prompt head did on its own prompt, so it is not a better drafter for any one prompt.
The candidate is not integrated into any serving runtime, so no latency, throughput, or end-to-end quality claim is made.
The base anchor was implemented and tested but was not exercised in a training arm, so no claim is made about it.
The published repository is private and remains a draft.
